feature: TLS HTTP/2 and WebTransport HTTP/2 through HTTP CONNECT proxies

scope.http2: Client connectTlsHostViaProxy APIs with relative, absolute, and unbounded entry points
scope.webtransport: direct EndpointClient setup and generation-scoped ReconnectingEndpointClient target
scope.proxy_protocol: HTTP/1.1 CONNECT carrying raw origin TLS and HTTP/2 after status 200
scope.deadline: one awake-clock timestamp spans proxy resolution, TCP, CONNECT, origin TLS/h2 ALPN, HTTP/2 bootstrap, and endpoint admission
scope.identity: the proxy resolves the origin authority; TLS identity, SNI, and HTTP/2 authority remain the caller origin
scope.credentials: Proxy-Authorization is present only on CONNECT and absent from origin HTTP/2 and WebTransport requests

reference.implementation: Hyper HTTP/1.1 CONNECT proxy and HTTP/2 origin
reference.boundary: Hyper independently parses CONNECT, authenticates the proxy header, relays opaque TLS bytes, negotiates HTTP/2 at the origin, and rejects a leaked proxy header

implementation.composition: HttpConnectProxy owns proxy URI, proxy-only headers, and HTTP/1 limits separately from origin HTTP/2 limits
implementation.ownership: CONNECT returns one raw stream whose ownership transfers to the TLS/HTTP2 constructor on every return path
implementation.validation: host and deadline validation plus authority allocation precede proxy network admission
implementation.webtransport_reconnect: the reconnect target reopens a new CONNECT, TLS, and HTTP/2 generation after transport loss; accepted Sessions are never migrated
implementation.settings_storage: four WebTransport current and acknowledged SETTINGS snapshots moved behind one lazy connection pointer
implementation.layout: archived clean HEAD measured Connection at 2176 Debug and 2096 ReleaseFast bytes; accepted code measures 2080 and 2000 while retaining the 48-byte public initial WebTransport limits value

native_cases: HTTP/2 proxy authentication and exact CONNECT authority
origin TLS 1.3 authentication, mandatory h2 ALPN, https scheme, and exact authority
transaction-safe zero-timeout and authority-allocation failure before proxy I/O
WebTransport Session and DATAGRAM through a CONNECT tunnel
first proxy generation closes, old handle becomes stale, second proxy generation completes a new Session
dynamic WebTransport SETTINGS retain separate submitted and acknowledged snapshots under failed output

results.hyper_release_fast: 9/9 build steps passed; h2c, direct TLS, proxied TLS, pool, redirect, cancellation, keepalive, KeyUpdate, and GOAWAY scenarios passed

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='HTTP CONNECT proxy' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='HTTP/2 connection keeps optional state compact' -Dtest-filter='WebTransport SETTINGS' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -Dtest-filter='HTTP/2 connection keeps optional state compact' --summary all
remaining_gap: independent draft-15 WebTransport-over-HTTP2 browser protocol coverage remains open; this gate independently verifies the proxy and HTTP/2 transport layers
